text: The pot-au-feu is as much a national institution in France as is tea drinking among ourselves and it is prepared at least once a week in every bourgeois household. Thackeray, of course, waxed enthusiastic about Bouillabaisse and sang -This Bouillabaisse a noble dish is,A sort of soup, or broth, or brewA hotch-potch of all sorts of fishes That Greenwich never could outdo; Green herbs, red peppers, mussels, saffronSoles, onions, garlic, roach and dace.
name: pot-au-feu, Bouillabaisse
